translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Daawite Saa'ooli Hayk'k'eeddawaa Siseedda
Saa'ooli hayk'k'eeddawaappe guyyiyaan, Daawite Amaaleek'a asatuwaa s'ooneedda saappe simmeedda; S'ik'ilaaga kataman laa"u gallassaa takkeedda.
Heezzantso gallassi itti bitanii kayyoo bare mayuwaa peed'iide, bare huup'iyaan baana laaliide, Saa'oola heeraappe yeedda. Daawitekko I yeedda wode, sa'aan gisiide goynneedda.
Daawite Aa, «Neeni hak'appe yaad?» yaagiide oochcheedda. Shin I, «Taani Israa'eeletuwaa heeraappe kessa akkaade yaad» yaageedda.

Daawite Aa, «Ayay keseeddentto ane taw oda» yaageedda. I Daawita, «Nu olanchchatuu olaappe bak'atteedino; nu asaappe daratu hayk'k'eeddino; k'ay Saa'oolinne Aa na'ay Yoonataani hayk'k'eeddino» yaageedda.
Oduwaa aheedda wodallaa Daawite, «Saa'oolinne Aa na'aa Yoonataani hayk'k'eeddawaa neeni ayaan eray?» yaagiide oochcheedda.
Wodallay, «kaac'aadan taani Gilbboo'a deriyaan de'ishshin, Saa'ooli bare tooraa guufetiide ek'k'eeddawaa be'aaddi; paraa gaaretuunne paraa asatuu Saa'oolakko matatteeddino.
He wode Saa'ooli yuushshi s'eelliide taana be'eedda; taana s'eesina taani, ‹abee!› yaagaad.
Saa'ooli taana, ‹Neeni oonee?› yaagiide oochcheedda; Taani aw, ‹Amaaleek'a asa› yaagaade zaaraad.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan Saa'ooli taana, ‹Taani loytsi maduns's'aade, hayk'k'oo mata uttaad; neeni ta bolla kesa ek'k'aade taana wod'a› yaageedda.

I kunddeeddawaappe guyyiyaan, hayk'k'uwaappe attenawaa ereedda diraw, taani Aa bolla kesa ek'k'aade Aa wod'aad; Aa huup'iyaan de'iyaa kallachchaanne Aa k'esiyaan de'iyaa sagaayiyaa akkaade neekko ta godaakko ahaad» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Daawitenne Daawita Asay kayyottiide, barenttu mayuwaa dafiide peed'eeddino.
Unttunttu Saa'ooli, Yoonataani, Med'inaa Godaa olanchchatuunne Israa'eeliyaa Asay olan wureedda diraw, omarssi gakkanaw kayyotteeddino, yeekkeeddinonne s'oomeeddino.
Oduwaa aheedda wodallaa Daawite, «Neeni hak'a asee?» yaagiide oochcheedda. Shin I Daawita, «Taani betiyaa Amaaleek'a bitaniyaa na'aa» yaageedda.
Daawite Aa, «Med'inaa Goday okkeedda kaatiyaa wod'anaw ne kushiyaa dentsaadde, ayaw yayabeykkii?» yaageedda.
Daawite bare asatuwaappe ittuwaa s'eesiide, «Ba; Aa wod'a!» yaageedda; I Amaaleek'iyaa dechchiide wod'eedda.
Daawite Amaaleek'iyaa, «Med'inaa Goday okkeedda kaatiyaa taani wod'aad yaagaade neeni ne doonaan markkatteedda diraw, ne suutsaa gomii neena oyk'k'o» yaageedda.
Daawite Saa'oolawunne Yoonataanaw Zilaaleedda Zilaassaa
Daawite Saa'oolawunne Aa na'aa Yoonataanaw hawaadan yaagi zilaaleedda.
Yihudaa asaykka «Wonddaafiyaa» geetettiyaa ha zilaassaa tamaarana mala Daawite azazeedda; ha zilaassay Yaashaara mas'aafan s'aafetteedda.

content.text: ne kaappatuu ne d'ok'k'aa gishuwaan hayk'k'eeddino.
Hewaa sisooppe, Piliss's'eematuwaa mac'c'a naanay nashettana;
ayaw gooppe, yaan wolk'k'aama gonddallii tunabaa kesseedda;
Saa'oolaw, hinttentta zo'onne alleek'k'o mayuwaa mayzzeeddawoonne,
Yoonataani ne d'ok'k'a gishuwaan goora'etti giseedda.

content: yaagiide Daawite zilaaleedda.
